title: Stonehenge Stables
specs: Instructors and students have won multiple national and international show jumping and equitation championships.
Max Amaya competed in World Equestrian Games and Pan American Games, holding record for highest placed Argentine in history.
Victor Amaya competed at CSI4* and CSI5* competitions in Europe and won Young Horse Italian Championships and CSI3* grand prix events.
TJ O'Mara has won multiple equitation championships and has international competition experience.

blurb: Stonehenge Stables provides personalized show jumping training programs for horse and rider, focusing on developing equitation champions and young show jumping talent. The stable is run by experienced trainers with international competition backgrounds. They cater to riders of all levels, from children and amateurs to professionals.
